==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He started playing since season 1.
* His favorite food is sushi.
* His second favorite role after jungle is midlaner.
* His idol is [[Faker]].
* The Spanish community nicknames him the ''cachorro/cachorrita'' (puppy).
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on August 10, 2025.
** The 17th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC.


=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Spring 2024)
* 1x LEC 2nd All-Pro Team (Spring 2025)
* LEC Rookie of the Split (Spring 2020)
